quarterly_data.quarter: Panasonic Holdings annual securities report: FY2026 (06-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal year April 2025 - March 2026 (IFRS): net sales JPY 8,048,722 million (-5% YoY), operating profit JPY 236,407 million (-45%), profit before income taxes JPY 263,109 million (-46%), net profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 189,540 million (-48%). Management states sales grew in Energy, Industry, Connect and Electric Works but fell overall mainly because the Automotive business was deconsolidated in the prior year; profit fell on fixed-cost increases from inflation, higher strategic investment and restructuring costs for the group management reform, despite higher sales, rationalization and a gain on the transfer of Panasonic Housing Solutions shares (to YKK, completed March 2026). Segment sales / segment profit (six-segment structure from January 1, 2026): Connect JPY 1,380,312 million (+5%) / JPY 100,096 million; Electric Works JPY 1,160,597 million (+4%) / JPY 57,675 million; HVAC & CC JPY 1,312,419 million (-1%) / JPY 23,149 million; Energy JPY 984,245 million (+13%) / JPY 69,795 million; Industry JPY 1,167,268 million (+8%) / JPY 40,457 million; Smart Life JPY 1,374,193 million (-5%) / loss of JPY 37,342 million. No single external customer exceeds 10% of sales
quarterly_data.figure: net sales JPY 8,048,722 million (-5%); operating profit JPY 236,407 million (-45%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Panasonic Holdings annual securities report: FY2026 (06-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management states that toward 2032 the group will address effective energy use and on-site labour shortages through businesses supporting AI infrastructure such as data centers and businesses supporting social operations; in FY2029 (April 2028 - March 2029) it aims for adjusted operating profit of JPY 750 billion or more, led by the AI-infrastructure businesses. Device area: the AI-infrastructure businesses are positioned as the group's profit pillar, aiming for sales of JPY 1.38 trillion and adjusted operating profit of JPY 290 billion in FY2029. The company plans to invest JPY 500 billion cumulatively over FY2027-FY2029 (April 2026 - March 2029) strategically in the AI-infrastructure businesses; the solutions area is to transform its business model by FY2029 by expanding service and maintenance on its installed hardware base (machines in the field)
quarterly_data.figure: FY2029 (April 2028 - March 2029) targets: adjusted operating profit JPY 750 billion or more; AI-infrastructure sales JPY 1.38 trillion and adjusted operating profit JPY 290 billion; JPY 500 billion AI-infrastructure investment over FY2027-FY2029

quarterly_data.quarter: Panasonic Holdings annual securities report: FY2026 (06-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Industry segment (fiscal year to March 2026): sales rose 8% on strong capacitors and other products for information and communications infrastructure and devices such as generative-AI servers (electronic devices), higher industrial motor sales on steady Chinese factory-automation demand (FA solutions), and growing demand for multilayer circuit board materials for information and communications infrastructure led by generative-AI servers (electronic materials); segment profit fell JPY 2.7 billion as restructuring costs for the group management reform offset higher sales of generative-AI server products, price revisions and rationalization. Sales by product: electronic devices JPY 593,498 million (prior year JPY 548,294 million), FA solutions JPY 102,856 million (JPY 84,622 million), electronic materials JPY 214,437 million (JPY 171,865 million). Panasonic Industry announced line expansions at its Ayutthaya, Thailand plant (scheduled to start operation in FY2028, April 2027 - March 2028) and its Guangzhou, China plant to strengthen supply of electronic materials for AI servers
quarterly_data.figure: electronic materials sales JPY 214,437 million (prior year JPY 171,865 million); Ayutthaya plant operation scheduled FY2028 (April 2027 - March 2028)

quarterly_data.quarter: Panasonic Holdings annual securities report: FY2026 (06-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capital expenditure (property, plant and equipment) for the fiscal year to March 2026 was JPY 629.1 billion, down JPY 139.8 billion, mainly because Energy's new North American plant started operation; by segment Energy JPY 431.6 billion (automotive lithium-ion batteries, new North American plant construction), Industry JPY 58.7 billion (electronic components and control equipment; 105.4% of the prior year), HVAC & CC JPY 33.1 billion, Smart Life JPY 31.4 billion, Electric Works JPY 28.7 billion, Connect JPY 18.0 billion. Capex plan for FY2027 (April 2026 - March 2027): JPY 480 billion (-24%), of which Energy JPY 238 billion (automotive lithium-ion batteries, new North American plant construction, AI-infrastructure-related investment), Industry JPY 83.0 billion (electronic components and control equipment), Smart Life JPY 45.0 billion, Electric Works JPY 37.0 billion, HVAC & CC JPY 30.0 billion, Connect JPY 24.0 billion. Depreciation (property, plant and equipment) JPY 229.1 billion
quarterly_data.figure: capex JPY 629.1 billion; FY2027 capex plan JPY 480 billion (-24%), Energy JPY 238 billion, Industry JPY 83.0 billion

quarterly_data.quarter: Panasonic Holdings annual securities report: FY2026 (06-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Group R&D expense for the fiscal year to March 2026 was JPY 426.4 billion (Connect JPY 132.7 billion, Smart Life JPY 71.6 billion, Industry JPY 58.7 billion, Electric Works JPY 51.9 billion, Energy JPY 48.6 billion, HVAC & CC JPY 46.5 billion). R&D results include a next-generation coolant circulation pump for data centers (high efficiency, compact, long life) developed for liquid cooling as data-center heat generation and density rise (Smart Life pump business); a transparent electromagnetic shield developed and commercialized in the fiscal year to March 2026 as a new application of the FineX transparent conductive film (Industry); and the Robo Sync platform for unified control of robots and cameras from different makers (Connect)

quarterly_data.quarter: Panasonic Holdings annual securities report: FY2026 (06-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Energy segment (fiscal year to March 2026): sales rose 13% as sales of energy storage systems for data centers grew significantly in industrial/consumer on the growth of the generative-AI market, while automotive batteries declined: North American cell volumes grew with the Kansas plant starting operation despite a worsening EV market from US policy, but price revisions tied to lower raw-material prices and weaker demand for cells from Japanese plants cut automotive sales. Segment profit fell JPY 50.4 billion: industrial/consumer profit rose on data-center storage sales, while automotive fell on US tariffs, higher Kansas fixed costs, lower sales at domestic plants and costs for past manufacturing defects. Sales by product: industrial/consumer JPY 547,026 million (prior year JPY 409,083 million), automotive JPY 431,414 million (JPY 471,896 million). The company says it holds a high share in distributed energy storage systems for data centers, offering its own safety mechanisms and cooling / optimal-control technology from cell development through system quality control, control and maintenance
quarterly_data.figure: industrial/consumer sales JPY 547,026 million (prior year JPY 409,083 million); Energy segment profit down JPY 50.4 billion
